batchConflictCheck.basis: Source batches returned both pass and gap assessments for checking methods; no verified cross-batch comparison resolved the difference.
batchConflictCheck.observation: Mixed local pass/gap is retained as an unresolved disagreement. The effective criterion and evidence-needed finding do not assert global absence of checking commands/configuration. Exact format/lint commands and type-check configuration are retained.

execution.method: Fresh byte/hash and exact-source comparisons; trusted workspace TypeScript syntax parser only.

acceptanceScope: Independent evidence for seven frozen partial assertions, not full sixteen-criterion accuracy or Static Review acceptance.
